gbm_population_evidence.quote: previously diagnosed with a GBM who have experienced tumor recurrence as determined by neuroimaging

candidate_evidence.quote: Evaluate effects of dichloroacetate (DCA) on tumor PDC phosphorylation.
The efficacy of dichloroacetate will be determined by the level of phosphorylated PDC protein expressed in surgical tissue.

candidate_flag.reason: Both registered arms are ACTIVE_COMPARATOR and both receive DCA (pre- vs post-surgical start); DCA is the investigational agent but rule 1 could be read as control_comparator

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Conduct a multicenter, open label Phase IIA trial of oral DCA in 40 surgical patients with recurrent GBM who have clinically indicated debulking surgery planned.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: The efficacy of dichloroacetate will be determined by the level of phosphorylated PDC protein expressed in surgical tissue.
Deidentified blood and tumor tissue obtained at surgery will be assessed at UF for biochemical markers of DCA dynamics.

role_evidence.quote: will be randomized to receive DCA (N=20) or no DCA (N=20) for one week prior to surgery.
Study medication DCA is a liquid formulation mixed with an artificial sweetener containing aspartame and strawberry extract (50mg/mL)

agents.drug_class_hint: sodium dichloroacetate; pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase inhibitor (metabolic agent, investigational for congenital lactic acidosis)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: effects on tumor PDC (pyruvate dehydrogenase complex) phosphorylation

flag.reason: All arms are registered as ACTIVE_COMPARATOR and all receive DCA; coded as candidate because pre-surgical DCA is the trial question

biomarkers.biomarker_other: phosphorylated pyruvate dehydrogenase complex (PDC) protein in tumour tissue

source_quote.quote: Level of phosphorylated PDC protein expressed in surgical tissue

coder_notes: Active moiety given as dichloroacetic acid (registered as sodium dichloroacetate, salt mapped to parent); script mapping should confirm. Design is NON_RANDOMIZED per registry though text says randomized. Both arms receive DCA (pre-op one week vs starting post-op); the comparison of interest is pre-surgical exposure for tissue PD. GSTZ1 haplotype genotyping is a germline pharmacogenomic dosing marker and is not recorded as a biomarker. MGMT is mentioned only as prior-therapy history ('truly unmethylated GBM do not require prior treatment with temozolomide'), not an entry requirement, so not recorded.
